# GitHub repository metadata

Use these values when configuring `oscout/scout` on GitHub.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Your personal agent cloud: a local control plane and mesh network for coding agents. |
| Website | `https://oscout.net` |
| Social preview | `.github/assets/social-preview.png` |
| Avatar / mark | `.github/assets/avatar.png` |

Recommended topics:

`agent-coordination`, `ai-agents`, `bun`, `cli`, `codex`, `local-first`,
`multi-agent`, `typescript`

Keep Issues enabled. Enable private vulnerability reporting before directing
security reporters to the advisory form. Discussions can remain off until
there is a clear maintainer response loop.

The npm badge in the README intentionally reads the live `latest` dist-tag.
Before a public release, verify that the package version has a corresponding
tagged source commit in this repository; do not hide source/release drift with a
badge or version-only edit.
